d.ko: Welcome to Scourge of War, a real-time 3D computer game/simulation developed by NorbSoftDev, the company headed by renowned game designer Norb Timpko, designer of Mad Minute Games' acclaimed Take Command series. Scourge of War is the epitome of historical command simulations.
d.en: Welcome to Scourge of War, a real-time 3D computer game/simulation developed by NorbSoftDev, the company headed by renowned game designer Norb Timpko, designer of Mad Minute Games' acclaimed Take Command series. Scourge of War is the epitome of historical command simulations.
d.zh: 欢迎来到战争灾难，这是由著名游戏设计师Norb Timpko领导的开发团队NorbSoftDev制作的一款实时3D实时指挥模拟电脑游戏，他是Mad Minute Games广受好评的《接过指挥》系列游戏的设计师。《战争灾难》侧重展现历史指挥模拟的缩影。
